defaults.composition: A single branch, cluster or patch fills much of the frame at a moderate distance, with the orchard or garden softly blurred behind but still readable, viewed from the side

shots.subject: A twig of apple blossom with pink buds, open white flowers and a few young leaves, against a softly blurred orchard of trunks and grass
A cluster of white cherry blossom on a dark branch with young bronze-green leaves, and blurred blossoming trees under a blue sky behind
Long grass and cowslips at the foot of an orchard tree, the stems swaying, with blurred trunks and a warm hedgerow behind
A branch of pear blossom with green-white flowers and fresh leaves, against a blurred row of orchard trees and a soft pale sky
Raindrops on young currant leaves in a kitchen garden, the leaves trembling, with blurred blossoming plum trees and wet soil behind
Dewy tufts of new orchard grass with dandelions and fallen white petals, the blades stirring, with blurred tree trunks in soft haze behind
A few pale pink magnolia flowers on a branch at natural size, petals gently moving, with a blurred lawn and beech trees behind
A sprig of hawthorn in white flower with fresh leaves on a hedge, gently moving, with a blurred meadow orchard behind
Unfurling fern fronds and broad wild garlic leaves at a shady orchard edge, gently moving, with blurred mossy apple trunks behind
shots.motion_elements: the fern fronds and the wild garlic leaves

shots.subject: A crab apple twig with pink buds and raindrops on the petals, against a blurred wet lawn and a dark hedge
A clump of bluebells and young grass under an orchard tree, swaying slightly, with blurred blossoming branches above and behind
Young broad bean plants with their first black-and-white flowers in a garden bed, the leaves stirring, with a blurred plum tree behind
A plum branch with small white flowers and green buds crossing the frame, with blurred tall grass and orchard trees behind
Moss and lichen on an old apple trunk with a small bunch of pink-white blossom on a low branch, and a blurred grassy orchard behind
A trickle of rainwater along a shallow garden stone channel lined with moss and primroses, the water moving, with a blurred pond edge behind
Willow catkins and new pale-green leaves on a garden willow twig, gently swaying, with a blurred pond and blossoming trees in soft haze
